sources.snippet: GymBot is a fully autonomous, full-stack AI fitness coaching platform. Instead of relying on expensive external APIs (like OpenAI), GymBot leverages a custom-built Natural Language Processing (NLP) pipeline to deliver instant, context-aware responses regarding workout plans, form cues, nutrition advice, and exercise lookups.
